name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.two_pow_le_card_of_locally_fresh
title: Locally fresh coordinates force exponential support: 2^|S| <= |P|
statement: Let P be a nonempty finite set of functions iota -> X (the possible values of a family of path values) and S a finite set of coordinates (paths). Suppose every coordinate w in S is locally fresh on P: for every g in P there is g' in P that differs from g at w and agrees with g at every other coordinate. Then P has at least 2^|S| elements. Local freshness at w is the support form of 'the value of path w is not determined by the values of all other paths', the condition an information-theoretic per-path hop at w needs.
